# Valio Aimo Trusted Trade Agents

> Governed procurement at fixed prices. All orders are gateway-simulated.

- [Developer connection guide and rules]({{BASE_URL}}/developers#rules)
- [OpenAPI]({{BASE_URL}}/openapi.json)
- [Tool descriptions and executable schemas]({{BASE_URL}}/developers/tools.json)
- [MCP server card (draft)]({{BASE_URL}}/mcp/server-card)
- [AI catalog]({{BASE_URL}}/.well-known/ai-catalog.json)
- [A2A agent card]({{BASE_URL}}/.well-known/agent-card.json)
- [Receipt verification keys]({{BASE_URL}}/.well-known/jwks.json)

Use authenticated GET /v1/me or MCP get_agent_context for your own scope and budget.
List tools over MCP at /mcp. Follow next_action in structured responses, retain command
idempotency keys on retries, and wait for a human when WAIT_FOR_APPROVAL is returned.
This file is navigation. Executable constraints live in tool schemas and current policy.

Accounts: POST /v1/auth/login (email/password), GET /v1/auth/session, POST /v1/auth/logout. Cookie mutations require X-CSRF-Token. Tenant roles are tenant_admin, approver and viewer; platform_admin reads all tenants. GET /v1/me includes tenant, connection and customer scope.
Connection catalog: {{BASE_URL}}/v1/connect/catalog?audience=buyer|tenant|operator. Types: MCP, REST, A2A, webhook, tool_pack. API keys are issued once; rotate/revoke and client instructions live under /v1/tenant/connections. OAuth code/PKCE with human consent is available for remote MCP/A2A; discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server. Human resources: /mcp/tenant, /mcp/operator, /a2a/tenant, /a2a/operator. Each has protected resource metadata; tokens are resource-bound. Webhook subscriptions: /v1/tenant/webhook-subscriptions and /v1/operator/webhook-subscriptions. Function packs: /v1/connect/tool-pack?format=openai|anthropic|gemini&audience=buyer|tenant|operator. Consult availability flags. MCP human decisions return input_required; echo requestState with inputResponses.decision only after human confirmation. Human REST decisions require a summary then a confirmed retry with its single-use five-minute confirmation_token.
